meta.title: Materialul Video de Duminica by AM (1.11.2026)
meta.thread_line: 6 threads · bounce-then-correction view on indices, VIX, dollar and oil · gold, silver, Bitcoin, Ethereum · mega-cap levels · AI and space names · software, fintech and crypto equities · cyber risk and the 2027 outlook

snapshot: Source note: built from an AI-generated summary of the video (no captions), so levels and a few figures may be mis-transcribed; the summary itself flags that the Fortinet numbers are unclear.
AM expects a **small technical bounce Monday and Tuesday** (Nasdaq futures from 28,500 toward 29,500) followed by renewed corrections; a 10-11% S&P pullback would be a normal annual one.
He would close gold positions and expects gold to correct, sees a first silver correction zone around 40-41, and is confident in Ethereum, adding a few with cash held for lower zones.

Mega-caps: bearish bias on Meta (750 then lower), Tesla (405-392, possible negative free cash flow), Apple (exit before the report) and Oracle (prepare for up to 73% lower); constructive on Microsoft near 400 and Amazon for 10 years.
Speculative names are pulled toward lower zones: SpaceX under 130, Palantir toward 140, ASTS toward 33, Micron lower after hype priced in; Vistra, SoFi and Nebius are the long-term holds.
A major cyberattack (a Cloudflare- or CrowdStrike-style outage) is the one way AI trade could stall; he wants to buy cyber on a big correction.
Outlook: a difficult 2027; corrections let funds accumulate shares, and the market then rebounds so fast it looks overvalued and gets missed.

themes.title: Technical bounce first, then renewed corrections across indices
themes.lead: AM expects a rebound early in the week and a retest of lower zones afterward.
bullets: The VIX tested the **23** zone; he would want to take risk from the level where the VIX turns up, including at resistance, while admitting his timing has not always been good.

Nasdaq futures (NQ) took liquidity near the 31,000 resistance and fell to an unvisited 28,500, from which he expects a comeback toward 29,500; days were too aggressive and on too much volume to avoid a technical rebound.

The S&P 500 would run with about 4% profit if AI companies were removed. An old resistance turned into support; two accumulation patterns leave open whether institutions distributed or accumulated in small tranches. A medium-term revisit of the lows would be a 10-11% correction, normal for each year. The Russell 2000 direction is unclear.

Oil is rejecting the 105-108 zone, which could bring interest back to equities; the dollar index had a wide rebound after February-March and accelerated from April, and a stronger dollar on higher oil means people sell stocks for cash or Treasuries.

TLT accelerated down then rallied sharply; he saw very aggressive call buying on its options chain and treats 93-94 and 100 as relevant. A larger fall in yields would bring the market back into correlation.

themes.title: Gold and silver look set to correct while he adds to Ethereum
themes.lead: After an overextended uptrend and a sharp shock, he expects gold to correct and would take Ethereum on dips.
bullets: A close friend is a gold maniac; AM says that after such a shock in an aggressive, overextended uptrend it is hard to retake the highs because institutions sold heavily at the peaks, and lows and highs are falling. He would close positions in the zone, at the latest at the upper zone.
Silver already corrected widely; a first correction zone is around **40-41**.
Bitcoin had a slight decline while Ethereum looks a little better; he has high confidence in ETH and will probably add a few, but also holds cash for lower zones to enter more serious tranches.

themes.title: Mega-cap levels: bearish on Meta, Tesla, Oracle and Apple; constructive on Microsoft and Amazon
themes.lead: He marks specific zones for the biggest names and leans toward lower prices for those with heavy capex or rich valuations.
bullets: NVIDIA has an S&P-like pattern with two accumulation shapes and he thinks the last one was almost surely distribution; a further accumulation forming a reverse head-and-shoulders could change that, otherwise a larger correction.

Google ($3.4T): four zones, 310-303, 290-283, 265-260 and 225-214; he thinks 290 may be a fake breakout that rejects. Apple is very boring and he would exit before the report. Microsoft looks like a good deal near **400** for those with entries there.
Amazon rejected strongly without reaching 220, institutions showed interest near 230; at $2.6T, AI and robotics should show in margins and he thinks it is well positioned for the next 10 years.
Meta: the 750 zone drawn long ago; a trend-down resumed and he wants followers ready for much lower zones, first a slight rebound toward 700, then continuation down while capex stays large.
Broadcom ($1.5-1.6T): zones 336-326 and 300 (zones carry a 5% deviation on stable companies, up to 15% on volatile ones); it needs negative triggers to reach them.
Tesla ($1.6T) is stretched against its P/E and falling margins; he sees free cash flow possibly turning negative in one or two quarters, from zones around 405-392.
Oracle is trying to form a bottom, but while AI is spoken ill of it is difficult; he tells holders with large positions to prepare for a drop of up to 73% to a zone he sees as very strong.

themes.title: AI, chips and space names: lower zones and earnings gaps ahead
themes.lead: He expects pullbacks in the crowded AI and space trades and doubts SpaceX's $2T valuation.
bullets: AMD broke a resistance aggressively and passed the all-time high on volume; Intel's report created a negative gap and AMD reports next week. Even a great report can gap lower as the market is emotional; the company has very large orders in advance but suffers from the collective market situation.

SpaceX: many opened shorts and puts, some doubled, then the report came in far better than expected; he thinks they cleaned out many at the end. He expects it **under 130**, then either a break far lower or a move up against expectations; personally he thinks the $2T cap is unjustified, as many buy it for the science-fiction world.
Palantir took two zones, broke 200 and began falling; he expects at least 140, especially if an exceptional report produces a correction like last November; 200 is vital for how it reacts.

Rocket Lab never went under $50; the 48 zone may turn from support to resistance and the report may add negatives. ASTS destroyed the 55 zone and heads toward **33**; SpaceX is practically entering their market. Intel will stop somewhere but will upset many and he doesn't expect people to add.

Micron: the first reaction zone is the marked one and then he thinks the fall continues; the numbers are good but already priced in on the hype that no memory chips will be found, like the period when crypto bought all the graphics cards. If the AI craze cracks, memory stops.
Nebius reacted superbly from the buy zone he marked, and Valentin bought in recent days; it depends heavily on portfolios for long-term holders.

themes.title: Software, fintech, crypto equities and energy: selective entries
themes.lead: He is long-term positive on Vistra and SoFi and waits for lower zones on Netflix, Fortinet, Coinbase and others.
bullets: Vistra was tested many times in the same zone, which raises the odds it breaks; he may see 120, perhaps on the earnings report. He stays positive long term and will add a bigger position because the energy it offers will be needed.

SoFi: the move is unclear, as the zone distributed on volume and rejected surprisingly hard; the gap formed after the report must hold, otherwise it was a pump so others could sell. He stays on his claim that once interest rates fall, SoFi has years of growth we cannot yet perceive.
Coinbase is trying to give up the **145** zone, which is starting to get interesting for the financial ecosystem ahead; he regrets not entering Circle near $60.

Netflix: RSI rising while price falls; he waits for about 65 to take a position, at roughly $250B, but warns it could be an Adobe or PayPal story. Fortinet fell a lot and he expects at least 105, with help even 70-80 (figures unclear in the source).

ServiceNow reached the expected upper zone and he expected a pullback near 110 as confirmation. CrowdStrike shows no sign of falling, but the relevant zone for him is below the 120 gap. UnitedHealth: he doesn't think anyone holds it anymore. Cloudflare broke its zone, pulled back and likely keeps visiting lower zones.
Robinhood: he wrote before the report that it could be bad; if retail walks away, negative reports can give very okay mid-term prices; he expected the 92 zone as a pattern.
Options note: he closed a covered call; if he doesn't want to sell the stock he can sell a put, collecting premium if price rises or buying the shares lower if it falls.

themes.title: A cyberattack is the way AI could stall, and 2027 looks difficult
themes.lead: He sees an ecosystem outage as the main hazard for AI businesses and expects corrections to be used by funds to accumulate.
bullets: Some people close to him run entire AI-built businesses controlled by one person; the only thing that would stop them is a Cloudflare- or CrowdStrike-style outage that takes down the ecosystem, which could trigger big drops in the heavily pumped cyber security sector.

He wants to buy cyber security on a big correction. When CrowdStrike fell 50% he wanted to sell his whole portfolio and buy it; Valentin told him to stop and he chose a balanced portfolio, which he calls a mistake.
Corrections and negative events are often how funds grab as many shares as possible; when the market returns it does so so aggressively it looks overvalued and you miss it.
He expects a difficult 2027; he hoped for a better end to this year, but the elections became more uncertain and it became clearer that Trump will lose.

Closing advice: rely on levels where risk management is more probable, don't copy Valentin's experience of buying anywhere on the chart, and in the first three years learning economics matters more than profit.

takeaways.title: Plan for a Monday-Tuesday technical bounce in Nasdaq futures toward 29,500, then expect corrections and fade strength.
Review gold positions near highs and treat silver 40-41 as the first correction zone.
Use marked zones (Microsoft 400, Netflix 65, Coinbase 145) with a 5-15% deviation, not as fixed prices.
Prepare to buy cyber security only after a large correction, since a platform outage is the main AI risk.
Treat AMD, Apple, Palantir, Rocket Lab and Robinhood earnings as gap risks even if reports are strong.

other_news.title: Political scenarios (his personal analysis, not fact or wish): the only way Trump and Republicans avoid losing the midterms would be an attack attributed to an Arab citizen and proven Iranian, which would let him halt elections; he gives Netanyahu a small chance via talks with Arab parties.

He warns that if General Gadi Eisenkot (who lost his son in Gaza in December 2023) defeats Netanyahu, things could be worse, because a man driven by revenge seeks chaos while Netanyahu is a predictable evil.
